nom: Seoul Ceuticals Korean Skin Care PDRN + Vitamin C Serum

avis.texte: I love that this doesn't have synthetic fragrance. That is what turned me off of strivectin. This stuff works just as good, possibly better!

In trying to find items to restart a skin care routine after years of neglect, this seemed like an excellent option. Combining Vitamin C and the hyped up PDRN seemed like a good idea, so I was willing to give it a shot. I won't say it gave miraculous results, but after a couple months of use and combined with a sunscreen in the morning, and retinaldehyde in the evening, my skin looks and feels smoother, hydrated, and overall just better. The scent is pleasant, a very light citrus that fades quickly, and the texture is also nice without a lot of slip or greasiness. It absorbs quickly, too. Overall, not a miracle product, but a very good product that's helped me out a lot!

This is a just anothet over hyped korean skin care product. I should have read the ingredients before I purchased it. Top ingrediants are : witch hazel, aloe vera and jojoba oil. I gave it 2 stars for scent and how it felt on skin. But the crosspolymer ingredient is a no.

I've been using this every day for about a month now and my skin has never looked better. Vitamin C is essential to use every morning and I have tried many brands. Hands-down, this is the best one I've used.

avis.titre: Noticeably Brighter, Healthier Skin Without the Irritation
avis.texte: I've been using the Seoul Ceuticals PDRN + Vitamin C Serum for a couple weeks now, and I'm genuinely impressed with how balanced it feels on my skin. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly without leaving any sticky or greasy residue. I have somewhat sensitive skin, and this serum didn't cause any irritation or tingling at all. Within the first week, my skin started looking brighter and more even, especially around my cheeks. After continued use, I noticed my skin felt firmer and more hydrated overall. It layers well under moisturizer and makeup, which is a big plus for my morning routine. I also like that it doesn't have a strong scent. My skin looks healthier and more refreshed, even on days when I'm tired. The combination of PDRN and Vitamin C feels gentle but effective. It's one of those products that quietly works in the background. I'll definitely be keeping this serum in my regular skincare rotation.

I really like this serum because it's several products in one, so I don't have to spend as much on a variety of bottles, and I'm getting great results. The serum is lightweight and absorbs quickly without feeling sticky. My skin looks fresh and not dull, and it feels soft. I use this serum after cleaning my face in the morning and I follow it with moisturizer. Definitely worth it!

What I like about this serum is more on the light weight side and smells great! So far I have used it day and night after toner and it seems to add on more hydration to my skin, I think it helps my skin look brighter
This makes my skin feel so good! It goes on and you immediately feel a difference in your akin. I cant wait to see what long term ise will do!

avis.titre: My Skin is So Soft After Use!
avis.texte: I love this skin care product, nothing has ever left my skin so soft! It is a great base for any beauty routine. I apply this before my lotion in the morning. My laugh lines are noticeably lighter. I will continue use for a younger face. 10/10!

I am really impressed with this serum. Overall I usually love korean skin care. This serum did not disappoint!! The serum is light weight, absorbs quickly and is perfect for under makeup. It has a light fresh scent that is very pleasant. This serum quickly became part of my daily routine!

This serum is lightweight and absorbs quickly into my skin without the oily feeling that some other serums leave. A few drops rubbed into my forehead, cheeks, and neck leave me with brightened, soft and smooth skin. Instant face lift

avis.titre: New addition to my skincare routine
avis.texte: Easy to use formula and i love the way it makes my skin feel. It smells lovely and i love how it has a dropper included. I will be using this and my new vitamin c serum.

This serum feels light and absorbs fast without being sticky. I notice my skin looks brighter and smoother. It feels more firm and hydrated with regular use. I like that it is gentle and fragrance free so it doesn't irritate my skin.

This serum is lightweight and absorbs quickly without feeling sticky. It leaves my skin looking brighter, smoother, and more refreshed. Gentle enough for daily use and works well under makeup. A great option for boosting glow and improving overall skin texture
